Dr. Lee

Educator & Researcher

remio saves me at least 6 hours of prep time for every class. It seamlessly synthesizes materials from diverse sources, like YouTube lectures and academic PDFs. As a consultant, I conduct intensive research. I used to spend hours manually saving links in Notion. Now, remio's auto-capture has changed everything. It works silently, effortlessly gathering everything I browse.  It's an incredible time-saver.
